an3.48:1.1: “Bhikkhus, based on the Himalayas, the king of mountains, great sal trees grow in three ways.
an3.48:1.3: (1) They grow in branches, leaves, and foliage; (2) they grow in bark and shoots; and (3) they grow in softwood and heartwood.
an3.48:1.4: Based on the Himalayas, the king of mountains, great sal trees grow in these three ways.
an3.48:2.1: “So too, when the head of a family is endowed with faith, the people in the family who depend on him grow in three ways.
an3.48:2.3: (1) They grow in faith; (2) they grow in virtuous behavior; and (3) they grow in wisdom.
an3.48:2.4: When the head of a family is endowed with faith, the people in the family who depend on him grow in these three ways.”
an3.48:3.1: Just as the trees that grow in dependence on a rocky mountain
an3.48:4.1: so, when the head of a family here
an3.48:4.4: his wife, children, and relatives all grow in dependence upon him;
an3.48:4.5: so too his friends, his family circle,
an3.48:5.1: Those possessed of discernment, seeing that virtuous man’s good conduct,
an3.48:6.1: Having lived here in accord with Dhamma,
an3.48:6.2: the path leading to a good destination,
an3.48:6.3: those who desire sensual pleasures rejoice,
